task: Profile and further optimize accepted-race verification without changing its acceptance policy

requirements.RVO01: Measure the warmed worker and distinguish checker cost from storage/SQL/validation work.
requirements.RVO02: Reuse exact immutable verification descriptors with bounded memory and build/content fences.
requirements.RVO03: Reduce redundant JSON traversal overhead while retaining every existing strictness/resource check.
requirements.R01: Preserve pinned contracts, exact race/lap ticks, account/lease/cancellation fences, ghosts and retry identities.
requirements.Q01: Record actual commands, original reproduction, test results, limitations and a task-only checkpoint.

findings.checker: Acceptance already uses a single pass through trajectory samples and ordered gate progress, without control replay or native simulation. The measured adapter remains around 1.6 ms on this fixture; its logic was left unchanged.
findings.surrounding_work: The original worker fetched the immutable track object and loaded its descriptor from SQL for every race. Strict JSON traversal of replay coordinates and the track document consumed more time than the actual checker. SQL finalization remains another substantial cost.
findings.scope: Actual process_one from claim through finalization, including rewards/PB projections, using a synthetic in-memory SQLite database, real pinned-engine geometry and the retained public five-lap path. The repeating replay file is locally warm. Upload, HTTP, cloud latency, PostgreSQL, long-tail cold tracks and production throughput are excluded.

changes.descriptors: prepared_geometry lazily reads the source document only if neither a process-local descriptor nor a matching durable descriptor exists. The worker passes the complete prepared descriptor to the existing checker, so a warm race needs no track-object read.
changes.cache: Reuse the existing single-flight cache implementation in a dedicated per-engine namespace. Keys include immutable document SHA256 and a fingerprint of every BUILD_FIELDS value, including the complete vehicle configurations. Retain at most64 entries and8MiB of encoded descriptor bytes; this is the additional encoded cache budget, not a whole-process RSS bound. Each caller decodes its own dictionary, preventing gate/manifest mutation from contaminating other races. Replays and player results are not cached.
changes.cold_path: Keep durable geometry in OperationState for restart/eviction recovery. Release the read transaction before storage pins, object IO and native compilation. Failed or wrong-build generation does not enter the cache. Existing final pinned-manifest/timing checks and account/lease checks remain authoritative.
changes.json: Use the iterator's scalar-sibling loop directly instead of repeatedly calling next(), checking the pending-stack top and handling StopIteration at Python level for every scalar. Container traversal still uses depth-proportional iterator memory. Duplicate-key checks, finite floats including exponent overflow, Unicode validation, exact nesting and node limits are unchanged.
changes.contracts: No rules/physics/compiler version, proof schema, sampling density, tolerance, timing, scoring or entitlement change. No new dependency, schema migration, persistent visual pack or external service. The verifier method's document annotation now admits None when its prepared descriptor is supplied.

measurements.method: 30 unprofiled warmed worker samples per variant. First job warms scheduling/state; a separate final job supplies cProfile evidence and is excluded from timings. Exact time12757 and lap ticks2634/2532/2531/2530/2530 are asserted for every accepted attempt. After static preparation, native invocation is replaced by a failing stub for every measured acceptance.
measurements.json: json-comparison.json: 100 alternating raw parser calls per implementation on a92963-byte real trajectory envelope. Original median4.6003ms; optimized3.6115ms.3744 differential acceptance/error/type/message checks agree, including nested/empty containers, budgets, Unicode, duplicate keys, NaN/infinities and exponent overflow.
measurements.interpretation: About20.4% lower local warmed worker latency, with one fewer track-object read and two fewer SQL statements per warm job. The checker itself did not become faster; the gain removes surrounding work. No cloud latency or million-DAU throughput claim follows from this SQLite fixture.
measurements.optional_ghost: The timed worker fixture omits optional ghost poses; real HTTP/native ghost behavior is covered separately by the10 passing native tests. Percentage savings for other payloads are unmeasured.

validation.focused: Descriptor warm/no-IO behavior, independent caller dictionaries, every build field, durable restart, entry/byte bounds, pool release before IO, failed-generation retry, concurrent cold preparation, wrong-build/content isolation and strict JSON guards.
validation.regression: regression-initial.xml:102 passed,1 skipped,29 deselected; robustness/storage JSON, optional bad ghosts, worker lifecycle, SQL finalization failure recovery and related resource bounds. The skip requires PostgreSQL; PostgreSQL and real-signals selections were explicitly excluded.
validation.native: native-initial.xml:10 passed. Actual pinned Godot4.7.2 staged project covers native-generated trajectory proofs, proper/altered/incomplete paths, creator publication, ghosts, rewind evidence, idempotent real HTTP worker acceptance, generated drivers and strict current/historical gate spans. These are local isolated fixtures, not deployed-player writes.
validation.original_reproduction: reproduce_preparation.py runs the unchanged warm no-IO assertion with the saved original function. It fails at the repeated SQL descriptor lookup. The current implementation passes. The original source is loaded in-process only; no runtime file is reverted.
initial_corrections: The initial helper name profile.py shadowed Python's stdlib profile module through cProfile; renamed it measure_verification.py.

A fresh standalone Godot project needs its normal editor import. The initial native call exited before that import; the corrected runner imports only its owned staged project and records its import log.
The initial diagnostic samples included cProfile overhead. Preserve baseline-profile.json/cprofile separately; use baseline-unprofiled-profile.json and optimised-profile.json for the stated timings.
Native profiling required reviewed execution outside the process sandbox; it uses the pinned engine and isolated SQLite/object files only.
One helper import-order lint finding was corrected.
